# TecBunny Solutions — full AI discovery guide

TecBunny Solutions Private Limited is a technology services company headquartered in Pernem, North Goa, India. We provide CCTV installation, access control, Wi-Fi and LAN design, managed IT support, AMC services, and website development for homes and small businesses in North Goa and the Sawantwadi area of Sindhudurg district, Maharashtra.

## Core service areas
- CCTV and physical security systems
- Wi‑Fi, network infrastructure, and structured cabling
- Smart access control and RFID systems
- Managed IT support, AMC and endpoint administration
- Website development for small businesses

## Location coverage
- North Goa: Pernem and nearby service areas
- Maharashtra: Sawantwadi area of Sindhudurg district, near the Goa border
- Remote support across India
